claims.text: v1 Mini (natural/low-cost) plus v1 Max (reasoning/tool-use) single speech-to-speech voice-agent models, Oct 20 (Min Kim); 90+ languages, 17k+ voices; ElevenAgents plus Realtime API with OpenAI realtime-protocol compat (endpoint plus model swap; WebSocket only).
Independent Artificial Analysis as reported: BBA spoken reasoning Max 98.8 / Mini 75.9; TTFA 0.57s / 0.62s; Full-Duplex Mini 95.8 / Max 94.1; Arena Max 998 / Mini 988; tool-use Max 87.1 / Mini 60.3.
claims.context: ElevenLabs blog reporting independent AA evaluation (AA pages unfetched)
